items.title: 1581 W Campbell Ave - Apni Mandi Market
items.summary: Request to allow the establishment of an approximately 26,000-square-foot grocery store (Apni Mandi Farmer’s Market) with off-site alcohol sales and 24-hour operation, including construction of an approximately 920-square-foot mezzanine, tenant-related building façade alterations, and associated parking lot modifications

items.title: 1875 S Bascom Ave- Entitlement Extension
items.summary: consider the application of the Pruneyard Center Association for an Amendment to the Pruneyard Master Use Permit to extend the approved phasing deadlines for Phases 3 and 4, which provide for construction of a five-story office building, expansions of the existing parking structure, additional commercial buildings, and related site improvements; and for an Extension of Time for the related Tentative Parcel Map allowing creation of a fourth parcel for the office building approved as part of Phase 3, so that the phasing deadlines and map expiration date would extend to December 31, 2031, on property located at 1875, 1887, 1901, 1919, 1995, and 1999 S. Bascom Avenue and 777 E. Campbell Avenue.

items.title: 1063 Dell Avenue – Conditional Use Permit and Tree Removal Permit (Resolution/Roll
items.summary: consider the application of Flora Terra Landscape Maintenance to allow the establishment of a contractor’s equipment yard for a landscape contracting business, including an eight-foot-high screening fence and gates enclosing the equipment yard and the continued professional office use of a former residential structure previously converted in association with an animal breeding and boarding kennel, together with related site, parking, and landscaping improvements authorized as minor changes to Site Approval “S” 16-61, and the removal of one pine tree, on property located at 1063 Dell Avenue. The applications under consideration include a Conditional Use Permit and a Tree Removal Permit.

items.title: Notice of Public Hearing - Abating hazardous vegetation 2026
items.summary: placing the cost of abating hazardous vegetation on the property tax assessment roll. Assessments and other supporting documentation are on file and available for public review in the Community Development Department, 70 N. First Street, Campbell, California.

items.title: Notice of Public Hearing - SB 450 Interim Ordinance Single Family Zone Districts
items.summary: adoption of an interim ordinance superseding a prior interim ordinance implementing Senate Bill (SB) 450 (2024), as modified by Assembly Bill (AB) 1061 (2025), to revise historic resource eligibility provisions applicable to two-unit developments and urban lot splits, simplify subdivision regulations, and eliminate design standards for certain Single-Family Residential Zoning Districts (Ordinance; 4/5 roll call vote).

items.title: Notice of Public Hearing - SB 480 Chapman Drive
items.summary: a request for City Council initiation of a General Plan Amendment to change the land use designation of property with an existing single family residence located at 480 Chapman Drive from “Neighborhood Commercial” to “Low Density Residential (<4.5 units per gross acre)”. The applicant also seeks City Council consideration of a reduction in application fees for the required amendments to the General Plan Land Use Map, Zoning Map, and Form-Based Zone Map. The application under consideration includes a mandatory Preliminary Application.

items.title: Notice of Public Hearing Budget fy2027
items.summary: introduction of the City Operating/Capital Budget. The City Council will consider final adoption of the FY 2026 Budget and GANN Limit for Fiscal Year (FY) 2026 at the Tuesday, June 16, 2026 City Council Meeting.
